channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: New wave of Hampshire firefighters graduate after intensive training
item.description: 15 new firefighters have graduated from Hampshire and Isle of Wight Fire and Rescue Service's Learning Development department.

item.title: 'We have a woke society and no banter allowed' - Letter
item.description: I am a 71-year-old male and am not surprised the media and government are worried about misogyny.

item.title: The 'tranquil' New Forest trail with 'ancient trees' and one 'cool' feature
item.description: Discover the Ober Water Trail in the New Forest – a scenic, family-friendly walk near Brockenhurst with tranquil streams and ancient trees.

item.title: Southampton recycling centres to close over Christmas and New Year
item.description: Residents are being reminded to plan ahead as the city’s Household Waste and Recycling Centres will close on key dates over the Christmas period.

item.title: Plans lodged to extend the life of a quarry
item.description: Plans have been put forward to extend the life of a quarry near Ringwood until 2041, giving more time to restore Ellingham Farm into an area of open water, nature conservation land, reedbeds, public footpaths and agricultural use.

item.title: Unpopular plans to sell off car parks scrapped
item.description: Unpopular plans to sell all of a council-owned car park in Southampton have been scrapped – but some of the site could still be disposed of.

item.title: Concerns mount over plan for 920 homes near Romsey
item.description: Opposition is growing to plans for a 920 home development near Romsey with residents warning that local infrastructure is already under severe strain.

item.title: Woman speaks out after being knocked unconscious and sexually assaulted on night out
item.description: A woman has shared her harrowing experience of being sexually assaulted whilst on a night out as her attacker is jailed

item.title: Plans to axe free parking could lead to 'damage' to tranquil areas of New Forest
item.description: Campaigners say they fear quiet parts of the New Forest will be ruined by drivers eager to avoid proposed new parking charges

item.title: Cameras installed after Evri vans accused of ignoring turn rules for years
item.description: Cameras have been installed on a road after residents say they have endured years of chaos and near misses as delivery vans ignored restrictions.
